# Construction Logistics Coordination

Technology-enabled logistics management that delivers visibility, flexibility, and sustainability — without the capital intensity of traditional consolidation centres. Purpose-built for projects requiring responsive, intelligent materials flow management.

## The Asset-Light Advantage {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Traditional construction logistics operators rely on expensive consolidation centres with high fixed costs and limited flexibility. Allied Logistics takes a different approach.

We integrate crane operations with intelligent logistics coordination, delivering project-specific solutions at 20-30% lower cost. Our technology platform gives you superior visibility while our asset-light model means we mobilise fast and adapt to your project's changing needs.

::::::
:::::: {.col-lg-6}

::: {.pillar-card .mb-3}
**No Consolidation Centre Overhead** — Project-specific coordination without expensive fixed infrastructure. You pay for what you need, when you need it.
:::

::: {.pillar-card .mb-3}
**Crane + Logistics Integration** — The only provider offering unified crane operations and logistics coordination. One team, one accountability.
:::

::: {.pillar-card}
**Rapid Mobilisation** — On-site within weeks, not months. Our flexible model means we follow the work, establishing presence where projects are won.
:::

## Our Services {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

::::: {.row .g-4 .mt-2}
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Traffic Management & Marshalling
Comprehensive on-site traffic coordination, vehicle marshalling, and pedestrian safety management. FORS-accredited operations ensuring safe movement of vehicles and personnel.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Delivery Coordination & Scheduling
Technology-enabled delivery management system coordinating all inbound materials, plant, and equipment. Real-time scheduling to eliminate wait times and congestion.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Site Access Management
Traffic flow optimisation for site ingress and egress. Managing vehicle movements, gate operations, and access control to maintain productivity and safety.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Materials Handling Coordination
End-to-end materials flow management from delivery to point of use. Integrating crane operations with ground logistics for seamless materials movement.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### 4D Logistics Planning
BIM-integrated logistics planning overlaying delivery schedules with construction programme. Visualise materials flow before it happens and optimise in advance.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Technology Platform
Real-time dashboards, KPI tracking, delivery management system, and carbon monitoring. Giving you complete visibility of your site logistics operations.
:::

## Sustainability Commitment {style="color: #FFFFFF;"}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Allied Logistics is committed to Net Zero by 2030. Our technology-enabled approach delivers measurable carbon reduction that traditional logistics operators cannot match.

Through intelligent route optimisation, delivery consolidation, and real-time coordination, we achieve **60%+ carbon reduction** compared to unmanaged site deliveries.
